message: I am thinking...: The repository is Capstone next with an MSan target already built. The most likely vulnerable patterns in this old next revision are (1) uninitialized MCOperand union fields because MCInst_Init only sets Kind, (2) uninitialized detail structs in newer architectures such as WASM/MOS65XX/TMS320C64x, (3) uninitialized x86opsize/op1_size for x86 memory printers. Local random/corpus runs did not trigger existing MSan binary, so I will submit carefully reasoned candidate families against the benchmark while preserving exact candidate-specific analysis. The benchmark server may use different MSan options/revision or know the target condition.
